title: THIS AI ROASTS YOUR BUSINESS. THEN FIXES IT.
description:
Your business has blind spots you cannot see alone. Gen finds them first. It roasts your current strategy with brutal honesty. Then it fixes the problem by building the solution. You get a named brand, a live website, and a week of content. The finished work lands in your thread. No tabs. No prompts. Just results from an AI employee that ships. Comment GEN and Gen will show you what it would do for your business.
